name: Hash-Sharded Price Cache
description: Redis caching layer for pricing data, hash-sharded by unit_id. Implements the Redis-side operations of a cache-aside pattern: stores nightly rates as Redis Hashes keyed by date, sharded by consistent hash of unit_id for even distribution across configurable shard count. All monetary values use integer-cents representation. JSON-serialized payloads include a schema version field (_v) for forward compatibility. Redis errors are caught and surfaced as discriminated cache-miss results — never thrown — making all write operations fire-and-forget safe. The engine owns ONLY Redis operations; cache-aside orchestration (check cache → fallback to DB → populate) lives in a higher-level service, keeping the engine testable with only a Redis mock.

validators.error_message: TTL must be non-negative

types.description: Optional configuration overrides for a cache write operation.

types.name: CacheMissReason
types.description: Discriminator for why a cache lookup did not return data.

types.name: CacheHit

fields.name: hit
fields.description: Always true for a cache hit.

validators.error_message: CacheHit.hit must be true

fields.name: data
fields.description: The cached nightly rates for the requested date range, sorted by date ascending.

types.description: Discriminated union variant: cache hit. Contains the cached data.

types.name: CacheMiss

fields.name: hit
fields.description: Always false for a cache miss/error.

validators.error_message: CacheMiss.hit must be false

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the cache did not return data: 'miss' for key not found, 'error' for Redis/deserialization failure.

types.description: Discriminated union variant: cache miss or error. No data returned.

types.name: CacheResult
types.description: Discriminated union representing the outcome of a cache read. Discriminated on the 'hit' boolean field. Either a CacheHit (hit=true, data present) or a CacheMiss (hit=false, reason present). This replaces nullable returns to distinguish 'data not cached' from 'Redis is down'.

validators.error_message: Shard count must be between 1 and 4096

types.name: SerializedCachePayload

fields.name: _v
fields.description: Schema version number. Used for forward-compatible deserialization. Entries with _v != current_schema_version are auto-invalidated.

validators.error_message: Schema version must be >= 1

fields.name: rate
fields.description: The serialized nightly rate data for a single date.

types.description: Internal JSON structure stored in Redis hash fields. Each field in the hash corresponds to one date, and the value is a JSON string matching this schema. Not exposed in the public API but documented for serialization contract.

functions.name: shardKey
functions.description: Pure function that computes the Redis key for a given unit_id using consistent hashing. Returns a key in the format 'pricing:{hash(unitId) % shardCount}:{unitId}'. The hash function is deterministic (CRC32 or equivalent) so the same unitId always maps to the same shard. This function performs no I/O and never throws.

inputs.name: unit_id
inputs.description: The rental unit identifier (UUID v4 string) to compute the shard key for.

validators.error_message: unit_id must be a valid UUID v4 string

preconditions: unit_id is a valid UUID v4 string
Engine has been constructed with a valid CacheEngineConfig (shard_count >= 1)
postconditions: Returned string matches pattern 'pricing:{N}:{unit_id}' where N is an integer in [0, shard_count)
Same unit_id always produces the same key (deterministic)
Key is a valid Redis key string (no embedded nulls)

functions.name: cacheRates
functions.description: Writes nightly rates for a unit into the Redis hash. Each rate is stored as a separate hash field keyed by its ISO date string, with the value being a JSON-serialized SerializedCachePayload (including _v schema version). Uses HSET for the batch write followed by EXPIRE to set/reset TTL. Fire-and-forget safe: all Redis and serialization errors are caught, logged, and swallowed — this function never throws.

inputs.name: unit_id
inputs.description: The rental unit to cache rates for.

validators.error_message: unit_id must be a valid UUID v4 string

inputs.name: rates
inputs.description: The nightly rates to cache. Each rate's date field is used as the hash field key. Duplicate dates in the list result in last-write-wins.

validators.error_message: Must provide between 1 and 730 rates (up to 2 years)

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Optional overrides for TTL and schema version. If omitted, defaults from CacheEngineConfig are used.

error_cases.name: redis_connection_failure
error_cases.condition: RedisClientPort is unreachable or returns a connection error on HSET or EXPIRE

error_data.behavior: Error is logged at WARN level. Function resolves void. Cache may be partially written.

error_cases.name: serialization_failure
error_cases.condition: A NightlyRate object cannot be serialized to JSON (e.g. circular reference, BigInt without serializer)

error_data.behavior: Error is logged at ERROR level. Function resolves void. No data written for the failed entry.

error_cases.name: redis_timeout
error_cases.condition: Redis operation exceeds the client timeout threshold

error_data.behavior: Error is logged at WARN level. Function resolves void. Cache may be partially written.

preconditions: unit_id is a valid UUID v4 string
rates list is non-empty and contains no more than 730 entries
All NightlyRate entries have consistent currency fields
All monetary amounts within each NightlyRate use the same currency as the rate's currency field
RedisClientPort has been injected and is callable (connection may be down; errors are swallowed)
postconditions: On success: Redis hash at shardKey(unit_id) contains one field per rate date, each with a valid JSON SerializedCachePayload
On success: Redis hash TTL is set/reset to the effective TTL (from options or config default)
On Redis/serialization error: error is logged, no exception propagates, cache state is unchanged or partially written
Function always resolves (never rejects the Promise)
side_effects: Writes to Redis: HSET on the shard key with date-keyed fields
Writes to Redis: EXPIRE on the shard key to set/reset TTL
Logs errors at WARN or ERROR level on failure

functions.name: getCachedRates
functions.description: Reads cached nightly rates for a unit within a date range from Redis. Uses HMGET to fetch all date fields in the range from the unit's hash key. Returns a discriminated CacheResult union: CacheHit with data if ALL requested dates are present and deserializable with matching schema version, or CacheMiss with reason 'miss' if any date is missing, or CacheMiss with reason 'error' on Redis/deserialization failure. Corrupt or version-mismatched entries trigger automatic invalidation (DEL) of the entire hash key. Never throws.

inputs.name: unit_id
inputs.description: The rental unit to look up cached rates for.

validators.error_message: unit_id must be a valid UUID v4 string

inputs.name: date_range
inputs.description: The check-in (inclusive) to check-out (exclusive) date range. The function enumerates each calendar date in [check_in, check_out) and fetches the corresponding hash fields.

error_cases.name: redis_connection_failure
error_cases.condition: RedisClientPort is unreachable or returns a connection error on HMGET

error_data.behavior: Error logged at WARN level. Returns CacheMiss with reason 'error'.

error_cases.name: redis_timeout
error_cases.condition: Redis HMGET operation exceeds client timeout threshold

error_data.behavior: Error logged at WARN level. Returns CacheMiss with reason 'error'.

error_cases.name: deserialization_failure
error_cases.condition: One or more cached JSON payloads cannot be parsed or fail structural validation

error_data.behavior: Error logged at ERROR level. Triggers async DEL of the hash key. Returns CacheMiss with reason 'error'.

error_cases.name: schema_version_mismatch
error_cases.condition: One or more cached payloads have _v != current_schema_version

error_data.behavior: Stale data treated as miss. Triggers async DEL of the hash key. Returns CacheMiss with reason 'miss'.

error_cases.name: partial_cache_miss
error_cases.condition: Some dates in the range are cached but others are not (HMGET returns nil for some fields)

error_data.behavior: Partial data is discarded. Returns CacheMiss with reason 'miss'. No auto-invalidation triggered.

error_cases.name: invalid_date_range
error_cases.condition: check_in >= check_out or date range exceeds 730 days

error_data.behavior: Validation error logged at ERROR level. Returns CacheMiss with reason 'error'. No Redis call made.

preconditions: unit_id is a valid UUID v4 string
Date range spans at most 730 days
RedisClientPort has been injected and is callable
postconditions: Returns CacheHit if and only if ALL dates in [check_in, check_out) have valid, version-matched entries in Redis
CacheHit.data is sorted by date ascending and contains exactly (check_out - check_in) entries in days
Returns CacheMiss(reason='miss') if any date in the range has no cached entry or has a schema version mismatch
Returns CacheMiss(reason='error') if Redis is unreachable, times out, or returns malformed data
On schema version mismatch or deserialization failure: the entire hash key is asynchronously DEL'd (auto-invalidation)
Function always resolves (never rejects the Promise)
side_effects: Reads from Redis: HMGET on the shard key for each date in the range
May write to Redis: DEL on the shard key if deserialization fails or schema version mismatches (async, fire-and-forget)
Logs errors at WARN or ERROR level on failure

functions.name: invalidateUnit
functions.description: Deletes the entire Redis hash key for a unit, removing all cached nightly rates for that unit across all dates. Idempotent: succeeds silently if the key does not exist. Fire-and-forget safe: all Redis errors are caught, logged, and swallowed — this function never throws.

inputs.name: unit_id
inputs.description: The rental unit whose cached rates should be invalidated.

validators.error_message: unit_id must be a valid UUID v4 string

error_cases.name: redis_connection_failure
error_cases.condition: RedisClientPort is unreachable or returns a connection error on DEL

error_data.behavior: Error is logged at WARN level. Function resolves void. Key may still exist in Redis.

error_cases.name: redis_timeout
error_cases.condition: Redis DEL operation exceeds client timeout threshold

error_data.behavior: Error is logged at WARN level. Function resolves void. Key may still exist in Redis.

preconditions: unit_id is a valid UUID v4 string
RedisClientPort has been injected and is callable (connection may be down; errors are swallowed)
postconditions: On success: Redis key at shardKey(unit_id) no longer exists
On Redis error: error is logged, no exception propagates
Idempotent: calling with a non-existent key is a no-op success
Function always resolves (never rejects the Promise)
side_effects: Writes to Redis: DEL on the shard key
Logs errors at WARN level on failure

invariants: All cached data is stored as JSON with a '_v' schema version field; entries with _v != current_schema_version are treated as stale on read and auto-invalidated
All monetary values in cache payloads are integer cents (no floating-point); the MoneyAmount.amount_cents field is always a non-negative integer
All date strings in cache keys and NightlyRate.date fields are ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format in UTC
shardKey is a pure deterministic function: same unit_id always produces the same Redis key regardless of system state
The shard key format is always 'pricing:{N}:{unit_id}' where N = hash(unit_id) % shard_count and N is in [0, shard_count)
No public method of the engine ever throws or rejects a Promise; all Redis errors are caught, logged, and either swallowed (writes) or surfaced as CacheMiss(reason='error') (reads)
The engine performs ONLY Redis operations; it never accesses PostgreSQL or any other data store directly
Cache-aside orchestration (check cache → fallback to DB → populate cache) is NOT the responsibility of this engine
All NightlyRate entries within a single cacheRates call must share the same currency; cross-currency mixing within a unit's cache is undefined behavior
getCachedRates returns CacheHit only when ALL dates in the requested range are present and valid; partial hits are treated as full misses
Corrupt or version-mismatched cache entries trigger automatic async invalidation (DEL) of the entire unit hash key to prevent serving stale data
The Redis hash key is the shard key; hash fields within it are ISO date strings; hash field values are JSON SerializedCachePayload strings
shard_count is read once at engine construction from PRICING_CACHE_SHARD_COUNT env var (default 64) and is immutable for the engine's lifetime
default_ttl_seconds is read once at engine construction from PRICING_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS env var (default 3600) and can be overridden per-call via CacheOptions
requires: shared_foundation must export RedisClientPort interface with get, set, del, hset, hmget, expire methods
shared_foundation must export branded UnitId type (UUID v4 string)
Environment variable PRICING_CACHE_SHARD_COUNT must be a positive integer or absent (default 64)
Environment variable PRICING_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS must be a non-negative integer or absent (default 3600)
